pr_title: drivers: sensor: tdk: icm42688: fix wrap-around
pr_body:
On the driver for the TDK InvenSense ICM-42688 IMU.

When converting raw values to integer and fractional (micro) parts, the fractional part must be a signed integer.

- Fix prototypes where the fractional part was declared as unsigned.
- Fix comments which did not match the declared type.

The values affected are:
- acceleration converted to [g]
- rotation rate converted to [deg/s]
- temperature converted to [Celsius]

Fixes: #84673
